set-hide-menubar-viewer-preference.description: Shows how to read a PDF's current viewer preferences, enable the HideMenubar flag, and save the updated document using Aspose.Pdf.

set-highlight-annotation-border-color-re.title: Set Highlight Annotation Border Color Red

set-light-gray-background-for-text-annot.title: Set Light Gray Background for Text Annotations
set-light-gray-background-for-text-annot.description: Shows how to change the background color of all TextAnnotation objects in a PDF to light gray using PdfAnnotationEditor.

set-multiple-viewer-preferences-pdf.title: Set Multiple Viewer Preferences for a PDF
set-multiple-viewer-preferences-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to combine viewer preferences such as CenterWindow and HideToolbar using bitwise OR and apply them to a PDF with Aspose.Pdf.Facades before saving.

set-pdf-permissions-allow-copy-block-for.title: Set Pdf Permissions Allow Copy Block Form Editing

set-pdf-permissions-allow-copy-restrict-.title: Set PDF Permissions to Allow Copying but Restrict Form Editing
set-pdf-permissions-allow-copy-restrict-.description: Demonstrates how to use Aspose.Pdf.Facades to set PDF security privileges, allowing text copying while disabling form filling and annotation modifications.

set-pdf-viewer-preference-and-default-zo.title: Set PDF Viewer Preference and Default Zoom
set-pdf-viewer-preference-and-default-zo.description: Demonstrates how to change a PDF's viewer preference to a single‑page continuous layout and set the default zoom to 100% using Aspose.Pdf facades.

set-pdf-viewer-preference-fullscreen.title: Set PDF Viewer Preference to Full‑Screen Mode
set-pdf-viewer-preference-fullscreen.description: Demonstrates using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfContentEditor to enable the full‑screen viewer preference for a PDF document and save the modified file.

set-pdf-viewer-preference-show-outline.title: Set PDF Viewer Preference to Show Outline Panel
set-pdf-viewer-preference-show-outline.description: Demonstrates how to configure the PDF viewer preference to display the document outline (bookmarks) panel by default using the Aspose.Pdf Facade API.

set-pdf-viewer-preference-single-page.title: Set PDF Viewer Preference to Single-Page Layout
set-pdf-viewer-preference-single-page.description: Demonstrates how to use Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfContentEditor to change a PDF's viewer preference to a single‑page layout and save the modified document.

set-pdf-viewer-preferences-fit-width.title: Set PDF Viewer Preferences and Default Zoom (Thumbnails + Fit Width)
set-pdf-viewer-preferences-fit-width.description: Demonstrates how to configure a PDF to open with the thumbnails pane visible, resize the window to fit the page, and set the default zoom to fit the page width using Aspose.Pdf Facades.

set-pdf-viewer-preferences-thumbnails-fi.title: Set Pdf Viewer Preferences Thumbnails Fit Width

set-radio-button-value-in-pdf-acroform.title: Set Radio Button Value in PDF AcroForm
set-radio-button-value-in-pdf-acroform.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF with an AcroForm, selecting the "Express" option of the "ShippingMethod" radio button group, and saving the updated document using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.

silently-print-pdf-to-network-printer.title: Silently Print PDF to Network Printer
silently-print-pdf-to-network-printer.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfViewer and send it to a network printer identified by IP address without displaying any print dialogs.

simple-pdf-editing-wrapper.title: Simple PDF Editing Wrapper Using Aspose PdfContentEditor
simple-pdf-editing-wrapper.description: Demonstrates a lightweight wrapper around Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfContentEditor that simplifies common PDF editing tasks such as text replacement, image removal, and adding attachments.

split-pdf-into-single-page-files.title: Split PDF into Single-Page Files with Annotations
split-pdf-into-single-page-files.description: Shows how to split an edited PDF that contains annotations into separate one‑page PDF documents using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.

toggle-fullscreen-viewer-preference.title: Toggle FullScreen Viewer Preference in PDF
toggle-fullscreen-viewer-preference.description: Shows how to read a PDF's current viewer preferences, toggle the FullScreen mode flag, and save the modified document using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.

underline-specific-phrase-on-pdf-page.title: Underline Specific Phrase On Pdf Page

underline-specific-phrase-page-4.title: Underline Specific Phrase on PDF Page 4
underline-specific-phrase-page-4.description: Shows how to locate a target phrase on the fourth page of a PDF using TextFragmentAbsorber and add an underline annotation with PdfContentEditor.

update-pdf-xmp-creator-metadata.title: Update PDF XMP Creator Metadata
update-pdf-xmp-creator-metadata.description: Shows how to read XMP metadata from an existing PDF, change the dc:creator field, and write the updated metadata back to a new PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.

update-pdf-xmp-metadata-custom-project-s.title: Update PDF XMP Metadata with Custom Project Schema
update-pdf-xmp-metadata-custom-project-s.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF, register a custom XMP namespace, add project-specific fields, and save the updated metadata using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.

validate-pdf-integrity-after-adding-marg.title: Validate Pdf Integrity After Adding Margins

validate-pdf-integrity-sha256.title: Validate PDF Integrity After Modification Using SHA‑256
validate-pdf-integrity-sha256.description: The example loads a PDF, makes a simple edit, saves it, validates both original and edited files with Aspose.Pdf.Facades, and compares their SHA‑256 checksums to verify integrity.

verify-pdf-attachment-after-save.title: Verify PDF Attachment After Save
verify-pdf-attachment-after-save.description: Creates a PDF, adds a file as a document attachment using PdfContentEditor, saves the document, and confirms the attachment exists with PdfExtractor in a unit test.

verify-text-annotation-position.title: Verify Text Annotation Position on PDF Page
verify-text-annotation-position.description: Creates an in‑memory PDF, adds a text (sticky‑note) annotation using PdfContentEditor, then loads the result to assert that the annotation rectangle matches the expected coordinates.
